annotations.title: Create, edit or delete a Pinterest product group

description: Create, edit or delete a Pinterest PRODUCT GROUP — the slice of a catalog a Shopping ad group promotes (one brand, a price band, a custom label). action:"create" needs name, feedId and filters; "update" changes name / description / filters on productGroupId; "delete" needs confirm:true. Read back from Pinterest. 0 credits.

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

adAccountId.description: optional — act as this ad account’s owner via Pinterest Business Access (must be shared with this profile)

feedId.description: feed the group draws products from; required on create

filters.description: Pinterest product-group filters: {"all_of":[{"BRAND":{"values":["Acme"]}},{"MIN_PRICE":{"values":10}}]} or {"any_of":[…]}. Keys: AVAILABILITY, BRAND, CONDITION, CURRENCY, CUSTOM_LABEL_0-4, CUSTOM_NUMBER_0-4, GENDER, GOOGLE_PRODUCT_CATEGORY_0-6, ITEM_GROUP_ID, ITEM_ID, MAX_PRICE, MEDIA_TYPE, MIN_PRICE, PINTEREST_PRODUCT_CATEGORIES, PRODUCT_GROUP, PRODUCT_TYPE_0-4, TITLE_KEYWORDS — an unknown key is refused by name

isFeatured.description: true = mark the product group as featured

name.description: product group name; required on create

productGroupId.description: product group to update or delete
